description: Ask Apex runs one plain task on our best matching tool and charges that tool price plus $0.001. The listed price is the minimum, for a call with no task. If none of our tools fit, an outside x402 tool is used only when its delivery score is 80 or higher: you pay us that price plus 10 percent first, and we never pay the outside tool more than you already paid. Nothing is signed on your behalf. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
